{{Dablink|For the Aes Sedai, see [[Atuan Larisett]]; for the Accepted, see [[Atuan]].}}
'''Atuan's Mill''' is a town on [[Toman Head]], a few days east of [[Falme]]. 

Residents of the town are fearful after a visit by the [[Seanchan]] invaders. They provide inconsistent and imprecise information on the invaders to the party chasing [[Fain]] to get back the [[Horn of Valere]] and [[Ruby-hilted dagger]].{{ref/book|2|41}}

== Parallels ==
The town’s name may be in reference to Ursula K. Le Guin’s novel, The Tombs of Atuan.
